title: Civil Code Article 420
text: A contract is considered concluded once the parties have reached agreement on all essential terms.

title: Explanation of Article 420
text: Essential terms of a contract must be agreed upon by all parties for the contract to take legal effect.

title: Example: Contract Formation
text: Company A and Company B agreed on the price and the delivery schedule. The contract is considered concluded.

title: Civil Code Article 325
text: Liability for breach of obligations arises in cases prescribed by contract or by law.

title: Explanation of Article 325
text: If a party fails to fulfill contractual obligations, the other party may claim damages or other remedies provided by the contract.

title: FAQ: Contract Form
text: A contract may be concluded orally or in writing unless the law requires a specific written form for certain types of agreements.

title: Example: Damages for Delay
text: A supplier delayed the delivery by 30 days, causing extra costs to the buyer. The supplier is obliged to compensate the losses.

title: Practical Note: Negotiation of Terms
text: Parties should document disputed terms in a negotiation protocol to avoid later disagreements about what was agreed.

title: Standard Force Majeure Clause
text: Parties shall be released from liability for failure to perform obligations due to force majeure, provided they notify the other party in time.

title: Note: Special Contract Requirements
text: Certain contracts, such as real estate transactions, require notarization. The contract becomes effective upon signing and notarization.

title: Civil Procedure: Filing a Claim
text: A civil claim must be filed with the court of first instance at the defendant’s place of residence and must include the claim, justification, and supporting documents.

title: Requirements for a Civil Claim
text: A valid civil claim must state the claimant’s demands, legal grounds, factual circumstances, and attach evidence supporting the claim.

title: FAQ: Court Filing Fees
text: When filing a civil lawsuit, the claimant must pay a state fee unless exempt under the law.

title: Legal Advice: Preparing to Sue
text: Before filing a claim, parties are recommended to attempt pre-trial settlement or mediation when applicable.

title: Example: Filing a Consumer Claim
text: A consumer filed a claim against a retailer for defective goods, attaching a purchase receipt and expert evaluation as evidence.
